name: BIT-X13.6 ACTC software-state benchmark
description: Public-audit handoff for the BIT-X13.6 Adaptive Cognitive Topology Computer (ACTC) software-state benchmark. A frozen synthetic benchmark executed 72 cases under 12 policies (864 evaluations). The predeclared load-bearing gate for the Bagua-derived 8/64-state grammar failed, yielding NON_LOAD_BEARING_SYMBOLIC_ENCODING within scope. The terminal integration therefore retains the 8/64 grammar only as a historical-semantic source and optional symbolic encoding, while preserving a grammar-neutral ACTC core: State Estimation → Continuous/Typed Operator Selection → Adaptive Weighted Topology → Thermal/Resource Feedback → Self-Mapping → Counterfactual Evaluation → Readout/Receipt. F2 remains NOT_OPENED. This release makes no hardware, quantum-computing, empirical-superiority, production-readiness, authority, or world-effect claim.
